title: CROSS-Calib: Selective Channel Calibration for Ultrasound Reconstruction
abstract: arXiv:2611.31684v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Ultrasound imaging provides views of internal tissue in real time for medical diagnosis. However, ultrasound signals may be affected by interference, and correcting errors and removing transient interference while preserving valid echoes remains challenging. We propose CROSS-Calib, a channel recovery method that uses predictions from other channels as references for amplitude and phase calibration, while a gate using context selectively combines calibrated measurements with predicted echoes to retain usable samples and repair unreliable ones. On the in vivo test set, CROSS-Calib outperforms all baseline models under gain errors and transient interference, while phantom tests show that the model restores cyst contrast with echo widths of wire targets close to the clean reference. CROSS-Calib can perform channel calibration and selective repair before beamforming to improve echo usability and image quality.

translated_title: CROSS-Calib：面向超声重建的选择性通道校准方法
translated_abstract: 超声成像能够实时呈现内部组织的视图，用于医学诊断。然而，超声信号可能受到干扰的影响，如何在保留有效回波的同时纠正误差并消除瞬时干扰仍然具有挑战性。我们提出了CROSS-Calib，这是一种通道恢复方法，它利用来自其他通道的预测作为幅度和相位校准的参考，同时通过一个基于上下文信息的门控机制，选择性地将校准后的测量值与预测回波相结合，以保留可用的样本并修复不可靠的样本。在体内测试集上，CROSS-Calib在增益误差和瞬时干扰条件下优于所有基线模型；体模实验表明，该模型能够恢复囊肿对比度，且线目标的回波宽度接近干净参考图像。CROSS-Calib可以在波束形成之前执行通道校准和选择性修复，从而提高回波可用性和图像质量。
tldr: 提出CROSS-Calib方法，利用其他通道的预测作为参考进行幅度和相位校准，并通过上下文门控机制选择性地融合校准测量与预测回波，在波束形成前修复不可靠通道数据，从而显著提升超声重建的图像质量。
